newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring, white bids down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring, white bids down.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat and soft white wheats dropped on Thursday in sympathy with weaker MGE wheat futures.
MGE May wheat futures were off 6-1/4 cents at $3.98-3/4 a bushel while the rest of the board was four to 6-1/2 cents down.
Farm sales were limited as farmers in Montana and South Dakota prepared fields for spring wheat planting which was expected to begin in the next few weeks, dealers said.
In North Dakota there was still snow on the ground, one dealer said.
Also, weekend precipitation could determine the severity of flooding in Manitoba's Red River Valley, a Manitoba Natural Resources official said.
The Red River Valley had seen normal seasonal temperatures in the past week and a half. Thursday's midday temperature was also at the seasonal norm of 37 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rapid melt or heavy spring rain could see higher levels than 1996 between the U.S. border and Winnipeg.
